name: EmberGradient
description: A raw WebGL fire shader: an fbm-turbulent heat glow climbs from the bottom edge through two heat colors into a dark top, while three parallax layers of flickering, swaying ember particles drift upward and burn out. Falls back to a CSS heat glow with rising spark elements when WebGL is unavailable.
a11yNotes: The canvas (or CSS fallback) is an aria-hidden decorative layer; children render above with light, shadowed text. Animation stops off-screen, at speed 0, and under prefers-reduced-motion (one static frame; fallback sparks are hidden). GL resources are deleted on unmount and a lost context switches to the CSS fallback.

propsApi.name: color1
propsApi.description: Hot core color of the rising heat (hex).

propsApi.name: emberColor
propsApi.description: Color of the drifting ember particles (hex).

propsApi.name: backgroundColor
propsApi.description: Dark base color above the heat (hex).

propsApi.name: emberCount
propsApi.description: Approximate number of embers on screen (0–200).

propsApi.name: heat
propsApi.description: How high and bright the heat glow rises (0.2–2).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
